SELECT p.dwd_id AS source_row_id, p.patent_id,
  p.pn AS publication_number, p.apno AS application_number, p.kind AS application_kind,
  p.country_code, p.country,
  p.pbdt AS publication_date, p.apdt AS application_date, p.granted_number, p.language,
  p.main_classification_ipcr AS main_ipcr, p.further_classification_ipcr AS further_ipcr,
  p.main_classification_cpc AS main_cpc, p.further_classification_cpc AS further_cpc,
  p.keywords, p.value AS patent_value,
  p.table_data_source AS db_source, p.created_time AS create_time, p.updated_time AS update_time, t.titles,
  t.title_en AS title_en, t.title_trans_cn AS title_zh, a.abstract_trans_cn AS abstract_zh,
  l.isdt AS grant_date, l.status, l.anticipated_expiration,
  c.reference_cited_count AS citation_nums, c.cited_by_nums, f.simple_family_number
FROM (SELECT patent_id FROM dwd_patent_title
      UNION SELECT patent_id FROM dwd_patent_abstract
      UNION SELECT patent_id FROM dwd_patent_legal
      UNION SELECT patent_id FROM dwd_patent_cited
      UNION SELECT patent_id FROM dwd_patent_family) s
JOIN dwd_patent p ON p.patent_id = s.patent_id AND p.is_deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN (SELECT patent_id, MAX(titles) AS titles, MAX(title_en) AS title_en,
                    MAX(title_trans_cn) AS title_trans_cn
                  FROM dwd_patent_title GROUP BY patent_id) t
       ON t.patent_id = p.patent_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT patent_id, MAX(abstract_trans_cn) AS abstract_trans_cn
                  FROM dwd_patent_abstract GROUP BY patent_id) a
       ON a.patent_id = p.patent_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT patent_id, MAX(isdt) AS isdt, MAX(status) AS status,
                  MAX(anticipated_expiration) AS anticipated_expiration
                  FROM dwd_patent_legal GROUP BY patent_id) l
       ON l.patent_id = p.patent_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT patent_id, MAX(reference_cited_count) AS reference_cited_count,
                  MAX(cited_by_nums) AS cited_by_nums
                  FROM dwd_patent_cited GROUP BY patent_id) c
       ON c.patent_id = p.patent_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT patent_id, MAX(simple_family_number) AS simple_family_number
                  FROM dwd_patent_family GROUP BY patent_id) f
       ON f.patent_id = p.patent_id

SELECT s.*, s.dwd_id AS row_pk,
       we.work_experience_date, we.work_experience_institution_en, we.work_experience_department_en,
       we.work_experience_position_en, we.work_experience_institution_zh,
       we.work_experience_department_zh, we.work_experience_position_zh,
       eb.education_background_date, eb.education_background_institution_en,
       eb.education_background_degree_en, eb.education_background_institution_zh,
       eb.education_background_degree_zh,
       tf.academician, rd.research_fields
FROM dwd_scholar s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT w.scholar_id, w.start_time AS work_experience_date,
         w.org_name_en AS work_experience_institution_en,
         w.department_name_en AS work_experience_department_en,
         w.position_en AS work_experience_position_en,
         w.org_name_zh AS work_experience_institution_zh,
         w.department_name_zh AS work_experience_department_zh,
         w.position_zh AS work_experience_position_zh
  FROM dwd_scholar_work_experience w
  JOIN (SELECT scholar_id, MIN(dwd_id) AS md FROM dwd_scholar_work_experience GROUP BY scholar_id) g
    ON g.scholar_id = w.scholar_id AND w.dwd_id = g.md
  LIMIT 18446744073709551615
) we ON we.scholar_id = s.scholar_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT e.scholar_id, e.start_time AS education_background_date,
         e.org_name_en AS education_background_institution_en,
         e.degree_en AS education_background_degree_en,
         e.org_name_zh AS education_background_institution_zh,
         e.degree_zh AS education_background_degree_zh
  FROM dwd_scholar_education_background e
  JOIN (SELECT scholar_id, MIN(dwd_id) AS md FROM dwd_scholar_education_background GROUP BY scholar_id) g
    ON g.scholar_id = e.scholar_id AND e.dwd_id = g.md
  LIMIT 18446744073709551615
) eb ON eb.scholar_id = s.scholar_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT scholar_id,
                  SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(academician ORDER BY dwd_id DESC), ',', 1)
                    AS academician
                  FROM dwd_scholar_talent_flag GROUP BY scholar_id) tf
       ON tf.scholar_id = s.scholar_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT scholar_id, GROUP_CONCAT(fields ORDER BY dwd_id SEPARATOR '；')
                    AS research_fields
                  FROM dwd_scholar_research_direction GROUP BY scholar_id) rd
       ON rd.scholar_id = s.scholar_id
WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT t.dwd_id * 8 + i.ix AS row_pk,
       o.org_id AS antitypic, v.industry_code AS node_id,
       NULL AS chain_score
FROM dwd_org_industry_tags t
JOIN dwd_org_base_info o
  ON o.name_cn = t.company_name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
JOIN (SELECT 0 AS ix UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3
      UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7) i
  ON t.industry_link_code LIKE '[%'
 AND JSON_VALID(REPLACE(t.industry_link_code, '\'', '"'))
 AND JSON_EXTRACT(REPLACE(t.industry_link_code, '\'', '"'), CONCAT('$[', i.ix, ']')) IS NOT NULL
JOIN dwd_industry_chain_info v
  ON v.is_deleted = 0
 AND v.industry_code = JSON_UNQUOTE(
       JSON_EXTRACT(REPLACE(t.industry_link_code, '\'', '"'), CONCAT('$[', i.ix, ']'))
     )
WHERE t.is_deleted = 0

SELECT p.dwd_id AS source_row_id, p.patent_id,
  p.pn AS publication_number, p.apno AS application_number, p.kind AS application_kind,
  p.country_code, p.country,
  p.pbdt AS publication_date, p.apdt AS application_date, p.granted_number, p.language,
  p.main_classification_ipcr AS main_ipcr, p.further_classification_ipcr AS further_ipcr,
  p.main_classification_cpc AS main_cpc, p.further_classification_cpc AS further_cpc,
  p.keywords, p.value AS patent_value,
  p.table_data_source AS db_source, p.created_time AS create_time, p.updated_time AS update_time, t.titles,
  t.title_en AS title_en, t.title_trans_cn AS title_zh, a.abstract_trans_cn AS abstract_zh,
  l.isdt AS grant_date, l.status, l.anticipated_expiration,
  c.reference_cited_count AS citation_nums, c.cited_by_nums, f.simple_family_number
FROM (SELECT patent_id FROM dwd_patent_title
      UNION SELECT patent_id FROM dwd_patent_abstract
      UNION SELECT patent_id FROM dwd_patent_legal
      UNION SELECT patent_id FROM dwd_patent_cited
      UNION SELECT patent_id FROM dwd_patent_family) s
JOIN dwd_patent p ON p.patent_id = s.patent_id AND p.is_deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN (SELECT patent_id, MAX(titles) AS titles, MAX(title_en) AS title_en,
                    MAX(title_trans_cn) AS title_trans_cn
                  FROM dwd_patent_title GROUP BY patent_id) t
       ON t.patent_id = p.patent_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT patent_id, MAX(abstract_trans_cn) AS abstract_trans_cn
                  FROM dwd_patent_abstract GROUP BY patent_id) a
       ON a.patent_id = p.patent_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT patent_id, MAX(isdt) AS isdt, MAX(status) AS status,
                  MAX(anticipated_expiration) AS anticipated_expiration
                  FROM dwd_patent_legal GROUP BY patent_id) l
       ON l.patent_id = p.patent_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT patent_id, MAX(reference_cited_count) AS reference_cited_count,
                  MAX(cited_by_nums) AS cited_by_nums
                  FROM dwd_patent_cited GROUP BY patent_id) c
       ON c.patent_id = p.patent_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT patent_id, MAX(simple_family_number) AS simple_family_number
                  FROM dwd_patent_family GROUP BY patent_id) f
       ON f.patent_id = p.patent_id

SELECT s.dwd_id AS row_pk, s.scholar_id,
       eb.education_background_institution_zh, eb.education_background_institution_en,
       eb.education_background_degree_zh, eb.education_background_degree_en,
       eb.education_background_date,
       s.scholar_id AS row_id
FROM dwd_scholar s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT e.scholar_id, e.start_time AS education_background_date,
         e.org_name_en AS education_background_institution_en,
         e.degree_en AS education_background_degree_en,
         e.org_name_zh AS education_background_institution_zh,
         e.degree_zh AS education_background_degree_zh
  FROM dwd_scholar_education_background e
  JOIN (SELECT scholar_id, MIN(dwd_id) AS md FROM dwd_scholar_education_background GROUP BY scholar_id) g
    ON g.scholar_id = e.scholar_id AND e.dwd_id = g.md
  LIMIT 18446744073709551615
) eb ON eb.scholar_id = s.scholar_id
WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.scholar_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT t.dwd_id AS row_pk,
       t.org_id, t.name_cn,
       t.sub_org_id AS affiliate, t.sub_name_cn AS affiliates_name,
       t.sub_org_id AS affiliates_company_id,
       NULL AS affiliates_country_code, NULL AS affiliates_country
FROM dwd_org_subsidiary_info t
WHERE t.is_deleted = 0
